recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中，母細胞大量增加並成群出現，細胞核深紫、核質比高、細胞質少，背景散在許多破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cells）；在此倍率只能判斷為急性白血病，杯狀核需高倍確認。
features: Marked leukocytosis composed almost entirely of monotonous blasts, frequently in small clusters
Blasts of medium-to-large size with high N:C ratio and dark nuclei
Nuclear detail and cup-shaped invaginations are not resolvable at this low magnification
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked leukocytosis composed almost exclusively of blasts, many arranged in small aggregates, with numerous smudged cells in the background. The blasts are medium-to-large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm; normal leukocytes are virtually absent. Fine nuclear features, including the cup-shaped invaginations described, cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with hyperleukocytosis, shown in this case by flow cytometry to be pre-B lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation
ddx.vs: At low power they may look similar, but AML blasts often show granules or Auer rods at high power and are MPO positive without B-lineage markers.
CLL shows small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and smudge cells, not large blasts.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Leukemic MCL has TdT-negative mature B cells with surface light chain restriction and cyclin D1 expression.
Burkitt cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT negative.
